DailyEntry.title: DailyEntry
DailyEntry.description: Daily earnings, operating expenses, mileage, and calculated profit for a rideshare driver on a specific calendar date.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the driver who owns this entry.

yearMonth.description: Year-month partition key in YYYY-MM format (e.g., 2026-11).

uber.description: Gross earnings from Uber for this day (revenue/addition).

pop99.description: Gross earnings from 99 Pop for this day (revenue/addition).

recarga.description: EV/phone/tag recharge expense for this day.

aluguel.description: Vehicle rental expense for this day.

alimento.description: Food and meal expense for this day.

manutencao.description: Vehicle maintenance expense for this day.

kmRodado.description: Total kilometers driven on this day.

notes.description: Optional short driver note for the day.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/daily_entries/{entryId}.description: Driver-owned daily rideshare earnings, expenses, and kilometers driven keyed by YYYY-MM-DD.
